data.title: Princess Nourah University and Mass General Brigham Launch Women's Health Program
data.content:
Boston, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Mass General Brigham have announced the launch of a Women's Health Program in Boston, attended by Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan, Saudi Ambassador to the United States Princess Reema bint Bandar bin Sultan, and senior officials from both institutions.
Stemming from a memorandum of understanding signed in January 2026, the program aims to build a specialized research and innovation ecosystem focused on women's health, advance studies and technologies targeting prevalent diseases among women, and improve prevention, early diagnosis, and healthcare quality.
The initiative also focuses on qualifying national talent, empowering Saudi female researchers to conduct advanced studies and translate outcomes into practical applications, and establishing a specialized research database, reinforcing the university's strategic drive to forge global partnerships that serve national priorities.
-- SPA
